items.title: Show HN: Sibuna an open source web application firewall with proof of work
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN,
We are building an open source web application firewall Sibuna to have more control over automated traffic from AI bots and crawlers.
Sibuna runs as a reverse proxy or alongside an existing ingress through forward-auth. It includes application inspection, OWASP CRS support and a wasm based management console.
Please try it, and give us feedback for improvements.
Github Project: https://github.com/insanai/sibuna

items.title: Show HN: Auro, a package manager built for easy creation of packages
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN! I've been building Auro, my little package manager, for about 5 months now and consider it ready for release. Auro is my replacement for curl | bash commands, as it makes it extremely easy to package binaries for it. Repositories can take up little space, and can even be hosted on GitHub Pages! I would love for some people to try and give feedback.

items.title: Show HN: Agents can now create iOS Live Activities
items.contentSnippet:
I gave my agents a way to create Live Activities on my iPhone lock screen.
Their notifications were becoming noise, so I built Agent Activity to surface what matters, updating in real time
Some of my fav use cases with agents I use like ChatGPT, Muse, Codex: 
- Birthdays of people I’m close with (from gcal + fb + linkedin), first thing in the morning
- What each agent is working on and what’s done
- Closest citibike dock with ebikes + train times before I head home
- Critical updates like root c

items.title: Show HN: Streamline,recommendations from your watch history on streaming svcs
items.contentSnippet:
Streaming apps only recommend from their own catalogue, and only know what you watched on their service. Streamline reads the GDPR data exports from Netflix, Prime Video, Apple TV, Disney+ and Max, plus Plex plays, so it has your whole history.
